name: Operation Meeting
description:
The origin of all has been revealed, and all shall return to it.
<Originium Pollution> Continuously deals True damage to units on it and greatly reduces their SP recovery.
<Active Originium Storm> Deals True Damage to units in its area every second and greatly reduces their SP recovery.
Environmental Conditions: 
Enemy movement speed increased, and some enemies will differ.

abilities.text: Attacks deal Arts damage when inside Originium pollution.
